text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Both you and Suzuka-san
are brimming with motivation, aren't you, Teio-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, are you taking your days off properly?
Placing too much strain on your body
is simply unacceptable, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
How about taking a nice, leisurely rest
once in a while?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's right, desu_ne~!
What if you push yourself too hard
and end up collapsing!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
For example, going out to eat delicious food,
or going to breathe in some fresh air...
You know, for a change of pace!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Breathing in some fresh air
really does refresh you and feel amazing!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Taking a day off just as
those two suggested might have been
the right choice after all.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right! Plus...
look at this bridge, it looks like it could collapse any second!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe.
...Ready when you are, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
Fufu, this seems like great trunk training.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Keep your balance and keep up the rhythm!
Alright, here we gooo!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That obstacle course earlier...
The uphill climb one!
The incline was totally insane~.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Hey, Teio.
Why don't we give that one over there a try next?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what is that?!
It's surrounded by mud all around!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aha~, I get it!
You hop across those set stones
all the way to the goal, right!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The stones are slippery from the splashed mud,
so it'll require quick judgment and caution.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! That's nothing for me!
It's a race, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, I won't lose.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san just sent me a photo earlier,
and the scenery looked so gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is wonderful to hear.
While I understand the urge to run, taking a rest
now and then is just as vital, desu_wa.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It looked quite deep in the mountains.
Could they be at a hot spring or something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. If it is a hot spring, it should wash away
their daily fatigue and leave them refreshed, desu_wa.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, their skin will probably be silky smooth
when they get back, desu_ne!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! Suzuka, look!
This path is dedicated to horse girls, and we're free to run all we want!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: An expansive sky... and a road that looks like it goes on forever.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, hah...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah! No fair!
Wait up, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sheesh! I'll catch up to you in no time...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, hah...
Su-Suzuka... are... are you okay...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hah, haa, haa...
Y-Yes... What about you, Teio...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm... barely holding on...
You're right, out here...
if we don't set a goal for ourselves...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
We'll just end up running on and on...
endlessly...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft, hah, ahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Guess we really can't help
running no matter what, huh!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
As long as these legs can move...
I'm sure we'll keep on running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Why on earth are both of you
covered in mud, desu_wa!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Far from silky smooth skin, you're pitch black...
Wait, an obstacle course!? Jeez!
Didn't you go to a hot spring or something!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... In a sense,
you certainly spent a relaxing time together, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Good grief, you two are truly hopeless, desu_wa.
